environment.description: Deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running the Flask app directly via gunicorn behind an nginx reverse proxy with default configuration. The nginx config passes all query parameters unmodified to the upstream Flask application. No additional middleware or filtering is applied. The /api/products/search endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication.

config.network: public ALB -> nginx -> gunicorn, no WAF attached
